questions.q: True or false? You look for the defender before the pass arrives.
questions.explain: Yes. Looking early tells you if you can turn.

options: Dribble ahead with your head up
questions.explain: Right. Look first, receive open, turn, then dribble ahead.

questions.q: The defender is far away this time. What do you do?
questions.explain: Yes. The defender is far, so you can turn into the room.
choiceExplanations: There is room ahead, so passing straight back wastes a chance to move forward.
Yes. The defender is far, so you can turn into the room.

questions.q: You want to turn with the ball close. Which move does that?
options: Cruyff turn: pretend to kick, then turn
Kick it far and chase it
